name: Schema Dialog¶
description: Use the Schema dialog to define a schema. A schema is the organizational workhorse of a database, similar to directories or namespaces. To create a schema, you must be a database superuser or have the CREATE privilege.

name: Schema Diff¶
description: Schema Diff is a feature that allows you to compare objects between two databases or two schemas. Use the Tools menu to access Schema Diff.

name: Send Email to recipient: Message

name: Send Email to Others: Others

name: Sequence Dialog¶
